body:
Supports the adventurers at the civic meeting and challenges criticism of their work.

Recorded role and choices

In the May 2024 meeting, Breeda votes in favor of giving the adventurers a chance and cites what they have already done for her and the town. She challenges Phelps by naming works such as the walls, range, farmland and apothecary. Her drinking and comic delivery remain part of the scene, while her documented civic intervention is kept as a consequential act rather than discarded as a joke.
